perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.description: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.

enhanced.name: Dragonfly
enhanced.description: Precision final blows create an elemental damage explosion. Improves reload.

perks.name: Wellspring
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

enhanced.name: Wellspring
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.description: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

enhanced.name: Moving Target
enhanced.description: Increased movement speed and improved target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Archer's Tempo
perks.description: Draw time decreases after every precision hit.

enhanced.name: Archer's Tempo
enhanced.description: Draw time substantially decreases after every precision hit for a longer duration.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.description:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

enhanced.name: Pugilist
enhanced.description:
Final blows with this weapon generate improved melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: Explosive Head
perks.description: Arrows explode after a short delay.

enhanced.name: Explosive Head
enhanced.description: Arrows explode after a short delay. Increases accuracy.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

enhanced.name: Successful Warm-Up
enhanced.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed for an improved duration.

perks.name: Meganeura
perks.description: Precision final blows create an elemental damage explosion that deals more damage based on the number of rapid precision hits dealt beforehand.

enhanced.name: Meganeura
enhanced.description: Precision final blows create an elemental damage explosion that deals more damage based on the number of precision hits dealt beforehand.

perks.name: Burning Ambition
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.

enhanced.name: Burning Ambition
enhanced.description: Dealing sustained damage more quickly scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.description:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

enhanced.name: Incandescent
enhanced.description:
Defeating a target spreads a longer lasting scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.description: Faster time to aim down sights.

enhanced.name: Snapshot Sights
enhanced.description: Faster time to aim down sights. Stability is increased.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Collective Action
perks.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

enhanced.name: Collective Action
enhanced.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of further increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.description: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

enhanced.name: Swashbuckler
enhanced.description: This weapon gains increased damage for an improved duration from melee final blows and defeating targets with this weapon.

perks.name: Adagio
perks.description: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for a brief time.

enhanced.name: Adagio
enhanced.description: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for an improved time.

perks.name: One for All
perks.description: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

enhanced.name: One for All
enhanced.description: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Archer's Gambit
perks.description: Hipfire precision hits grant a massive draw-speed bonus for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Archer's Gambit
enhanced.description: Hipfire precision hits grant a massive draw speed bonus for an improved duration. Further precision hits extend the duration.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

enhanced.name: Frenzy
enhanced.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon for an improved duration until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn Enhanced
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. While this buff is active, grenade or melee final blows of the same damage type greatly increase its damage for an improved duration.
